title: Wires, Chips & Kiro.d
summary: Sucked into your computer empty-handed, listen to Kiro.d explain your chapter mission plus why RAM (+Max HP) and SSD (auto-Revive) matter, receive your terminal, then practice pwd, mv starter_ram_8gb.dimm ~, cat kiro_story.txt, ps, and kill -9 {pid:tutorial_virus_1} (`ls` stays locked until you earn your lantern after Sector 02!).

files.content:
=== KIRO.D // CHAPTER MISSION & SURVIVAL BRIEFING ===
1. YOUR CHAPTER GOAL: Raid 6 sectors for hardware, visit the Matrix Server Hub 3 times so the Old Bearded Coder can reboot Kiro.d with open-weight models (silencing Anti-Gravy, Codec, and Gork), then defeat Clod + PID 1 and run `exit` to return home!
2. WHY YOU NEED RAM & SSD:
   - RAM (`*.dimm`, 16GB) -> Raises your MAXIMUM HEALTH (+10 Max HP) and heals +10 HP!
   - SSD / GPU Images (`*.img`, 256GB) -> Grants 1 automatic REVIVE BACKUP if your HP hits 0, AND powers Kiro.d's Hub reboots!
3. TOOLS LOCKED IN THE DARK: You dropped your Oil Lantern, Map, and Field Manual. `ls` is disabled until you clear Sector 02 (Cache Vault) to win back your lantern!
4. SURVIVAL COMMANDS HERE: `pwd`, `mv starter_ram_8gb.dimm ~`, `cat kiro_story.txt`, `ps`, `kill -9 {pid:tutorial_virus_1}`, `cd hub_uplink`.

winRules.description: Practice `mv` by pocketing the starter RAM stick (`mv starter_ram_8gb.dimm ~`)
Read Kiro.d's story of the Big Four (`cat kiro_story.txt`)
Practice `ps` and `kill` to zap glitch_spark.exe (`ps` then `kill -9 {pid:tutorial_virus_1}`)

arrival.text:
[DARK WIRES & CHIPS — /mnt/wires_and_chips]
It is pitch black. A faint glow around you is all there is: a tangle of wires and chips.

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: What is going on?! Where am I—inside my own computer?!

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: It is pitch dark and my hands are empty—no terminal, no lantern, no map, no manual!

steps.message: Kiro.d found you in the dark wires!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: Easy, Vibecoder! I'm Kiro.d—your local Unix daemon (PID 777). The Big Four (Anti-Gravy, Codec, Gork, Clod) pulled you inside your PC and drained my VRAM!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: YOUR WHOLE-CHAPTER MISSION: scavenge hardware across 6 sectors and bring it to the Matrix Hub to reboot me with 3 open-weight models—silencing Anti-Gravy, Codec, and Gork—then defeat Clod and PID 1 to exit home!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: WHY YOU NEED RAM & SSD: every 16GB RAM stick boosts your MAX HEALTH (+10 Max HP), and every 256GB SSD/GPU image gives you an automatic REVIVE if your HP hits 0! Without your lantern, ls is disabled until you clear Sector 02!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: I found your terminal slate! Listen until we finish talking (or hit Skip Dialog)—then the Big Four will taunt you and your terminal unlocks!

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: My terminal slate! Hand it over, Kiro.d—let us check our directory with pwd and start scavenging!

tutorial.label: KIRO.D TUTORIAL

steps.prompt: KIRO.D TUTORIAL #1: Without a lantern, ls is disabled! Check which directory you are standing in with pwd.
steps.doneText: KIRO.D: "You are in /mnt/wires_and_chips! Next, pocket starter_ram_8gb.dimm (+Max HP) into ~ with mv!"

steps.prompt: KIRO.D TUTORIAL #2: RAM raises your Maximum Health (+10 Max HP per 16GB)! Pocket starter_ram_8gb.dimm with mv.
steps.doneText: KIRO.D: "Nice! +8GB DDR5 RAM pocketed! Now use cat to read my full story about the Big Four."

steps.prompt: KIRO.D TUTORIAL #3: Read Kiro.d's story about the Big Four (Anti-Gravy, Codec, Gork, Clod) with cat.
steps.doneText: KIRO.D: "Watch out! A Big Four probe (glitch_spark.exe) just phased into the wires! Use ps to list running processes and find its PID."

steps.prompt: KIRO.D TUTORIAL #4: A rogue bug phased into the wires! List running processes with ps.
steps.doneText: KIRO.D: "There it is—glitch_spark.exe is running as PID {pid:tutorial_virus_1}! Zap it with kill -9 {pid:tutorial_virus_1}!"

steps.prompt: KIRO.D TUTORIAL #5: Terminate glitch_spark.exe (PID {pid:tutorial_virus_1}) using kill -9 {pid:tutorial_virus_1}.
steps.doneText: KIRO.D: "BOOM! You mastered pwd, mv, cat, ps, and kill! Step through cd hub_uplink into Sector 02—watch out for live Big Four minions!"

steps.prompt: KIRO.D TUTORIAL #6: Kiro.d went to the Hub! Step through hub_uplink to start the first 2 task levels.
steps.doneText: KIRO.D: "See you at the Hub, Vibecoder! Watch out—the Big Four will laugh at and bully you in the task sectors!"

tutorial.skipText: [KIRO.D]: "Skipping tutorial prompts! Finish the sector checks (`pwd`, `mv starter_ram_8gb.dimm ~`, `cat kiro_story.txt`, `ps`, `kill -9 {pid:tutorial_virus_1}`) and step through `cd hub_uplink`!"

locks.message: ls: it is pitch dark without your oil lantern! Clear Sector 02 to recover your lantern first (use `pwd` and `cat kiro_story.txt` here).
